text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but a realized gain alone does not mean selling was wise; I should base decisions on future risk and return.","I sometimes bought back stocks after selling them, so I should avoid trades driven by regret or a wish to reverse an earlier decision.","Recent price moves are random and my few months of results reveal no reliable pattern; I should trade infrequently and keep diversification and my overall plan in focus."]}
